blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Anti-narcotics agents arrested a 41-year-old man after seizing from him around 15 grams of suspected shabu during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Siloh, Diay, Zamboanga Sibugay, Sunday morning. In a statement, the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency Regional Office – Region 9 (PDEA-9) identified the suspect as “Jumar,” a resident of neighboring Barangay Salinding. Operatives from the PDEA-9 – Zamboanga Sibugay Provincial Office conducted the entrapment operation at around 10:10 a.m., leading to the suspect’s immediate arrest.
